---
title: "DetailedPlan"
format: html
---

```{r}
dp<- read.csv('DetailedPlan.csv', check.names = FALSE)
tcb<- c("T", "B", "C")
colnames(dp)
addlb<- function(x) {
  x|> 
    gsub(pattern = " B: ", replacement = " \nB: ") |>
    gsub(pattern = " C: ", replacement = " \nC: ") 
}

library(kableExtra)
apply(dp, 2, addlb) |>
  kbl() %>%
  kable_paper() %>%
  column_spec(2, extra_css = "white-space: pre-wrap;")

library(DT)
apply(dp, 2, addlb) |> kbl() |>
  pack_rows(index = table(dp$Part)) |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

```


```{r}
library(readr)

reactable(
  dp,
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
datatable(
  mtcars |> dplyr::arrange(cyl) |> group_by(cyl),
  filter = "top",
  extensions = "RowGroup",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    rowGroup = list(dataSrc = 2) # Group by 3rd column (cyl)
  )
)


exdst<- data.frame(group=c(letters[1:2]), VarA = c('A:Something B:Important C:Hidden', 'A:But B:We Cannot C: See', 'A:We B:Cannot C: See', 'A:Hidden B:Important C:Thing'))


exdst |> kbl()


datatable(
  mtcars |> dplyr::arrange(cyl) |> transmute(Group=cyl, mpg, hp),
  extensions = "RowGroup",
  options = list(
    rowGroup = list(dataSrc = 1), # Group by first column ("Group")
    pageLength = 12,
    ordering = FALSE,
    # Custom JS to make groups collapsible
    drawCallback = JS(
      "var api = this.api();
       var rows = api.rows({page:'current'}).nodes();
       var last = null;
       api.column(0, {page:'current'}).data().each(function(group, i) {
         if (last !== group) {
           $(rows).eq(i).before(
             '<tr class=\"group\"><td colspan=\"3\" style=\"cursor:pointer; background:#f0f0f0; font-weight:bold;\">'+group+'</td></tr>'
           );
           last = group;
         }
       });
       $('.group').off('click').on('click', function() {
         var name = $(this).text();
         var visible = api.rows().eq(0).filter(function(idx) {
           return api.cell(idx, 0).data() === name;
         }).nodes().to$().is(':visible');
         api.rows().eq(0).filter(function(idx) {
           return api.cell(idx, 0).data() === name;
         }).nodes().to$().toggle(!visible);
       });"
    )
  ),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```


```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# Your data
df <- data.frame(
  group = c('a', 'b', 'a', 'b'),
  VarA = c(
    'A:Something B:Important C:Hidden',
    'A:But B:We Cannot C: See',
    'A:We B:Cannot C: See',
    'A:Hidden B:Important C:Thing'
  )
)

# Function to add newlines before B: and C:
format_varA <- function(text) {
  text <- str_replace_all(text, " B:", "\nB:")
  text <- str_replace_all(text, " C:", "\nC:")
  return(text)
}

# Apply formatting and group
df_formatted <- df %>%
  mutate(VarA = sapply(VarA, format_varA)) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(VarA = paste(VarA, collapse = "\n\n")) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create table with line breaks using kableExtra
df_formatted %>%
  kbl() %>%
  kable_paper() %>%
  column_spec(2, extra_css = "white-space: pre-wrap;")

```
